summary: Direct authoring task continued. v2 extends the in-tree C#-developer doc tree with the type system (PLang/app/type/start.md) and the value lattice (PLang/app/type/item/start.md). Both pages were drafted by Haiku subagents from verified-facts briefs and the v1 style reference, then every precise claim was checked against source (the full 18-row rank table matched the Rank => overrides exactly; all cited filenames exist). Each page maps plang -> C# -> source and points to the runtime teaching layer rather than duplicating it.

changes.description: The type system: entity vs registry, the CLR<->plang PlangName map, kind-is-behaviour (a file format is a kind of its type), app.type/type.root (the format in play), property + catalog, the current<T,L> generic, and birth vs make. Distributed CLR ownership via each family's this.Owns.cs.

The value lattice: the apex item.@this (storage-free; truthiness + lazy narrow), item.Create (the 6-rung inferred lift with walk-throughs), a full 'how item.list works' section (store-raw-type-on-read, chunks, snapshots, query surface, X.list = list<X> so no plurals), item.dict, the scalar types with backing + rank, number.kind.int, and the full rank/coercion table.

findings.issue: The XML doc on the this[System.Type clrType] indexer says it returns null when the CLR type names no plang type ('Null on miss'), but the code routes an unowned CLR type through PlangName to ('clr', null) and returns the clr entity, never null.
findings.detail: The doc page (PLang/app/type/start.md) describes the actual behaviour (unowned -> clr). The source XML comment should be corrected to match. Minor; not doc-blocking.
